mode: complementary 2T2MTJ bitcell digital CIM; exact integer arithmetic conditional on correct storage/sensing
kind: conditional engineering estimate; not a measured combined macro or BER guarantee

mapping.encoding_location: local 64-bit logical data expands to 128 physical P/AP target bits before shared physical interface
mapping.boundary_restore: covered by read-slot initialization and final control tick
mapping.required_resources: one segmented selected row, 128 direction-capable write paths and aggregate SL current for 128 MTJs; left/right isolated absolute-state read mux, reference and 64 single-ended sense lanes; no extra replica

retry_model.group_pressure_rule: 192*p is a union-bound-scale pressure illustration only; it does not change main service time
retry_model.pressure_limit: p is imported from MRAM-03 and its finite zero-error floor, not a measured probability for the new 2T2MTJ implementation
assumptions: main scenario completes and passes both-branch absolute-state verify within one full attempt
comparison completes and passes after exactly one whole-group rewrite; failed attempt time is retained
verify must be qualified at the chosen bias/load; exact arithmetic contract is conditional on correct storage and sensing
failure outside the finite budget is not counted as completed payload; no indefinite retry policy or success-probability guarantee is asserted
retry_model.payload_rule: only one successfully completed logical group counted; all internal writes/verifies/retries are occupancy

comparison.kind: conditional successful completion on second full attempt, not universal or prescribed retry count

stage_coverage.write_access: 20/30 ns engineering single-direction physical slots anchored to published full write access; cover drive initialization, pulse/switching/stop/recovery; published access has no portable substage decomposition
stage_coverage.verify_read: one complete reusable low-bias single-ended branch read/reset/mux slot per batch; two branches separately
stage_coverage.turn: one digital tick between two direction slots
stage_coverage.compare: one digital tick per 64-bit branch comparison; pair validity accumulated
stage_coverage.front: shared API front_ns physical encoded loading with first beat in command and two control ticks
stage_coverage.stream: complete media read/reset/digitization followed by shared integer compute tick; no ADC or TDC

maintenance.condition: nondestructive qualified low-bias read; no retention-refresh claim outside service window
maintenance.endurance: separate feasibility constraint; two-phase complement refresh stresses cells unequally; no universal cycle rating imported

selection_rules.reason: MRAM-06 supports independent local bitcell digitization; its 256-term/64-bank organization is not a universal MRAM restriction

selection_rules.choice: B_R=8 Byte and 128 physical target bits
selection_rules.reason: 64 complementary weight bits limited by explicitly provisioned 128 first-phase write paths

selection_rules.choice: complete write-access slot replaces its internal timing; only interphase control, independent two-branch verify and local interface added
selection_rules.reason: MRAM-03 full write access and MRAM-06 two-step write/row retry
